import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int INF = 1 << 29;
    static final int MAXN = 500;
    static boolean[][] m;
    static List<Integer>[] g;
    static List<Edge> e;
    static int[] d, ptr;
    static int n, t, xb, yb;
    static int[][] temp, kaps;

    static class Edge {
        int a, b, cap, flow;
        Edge(int a, int b, int cap, int flow) {
            this.a = a;
            this.b = b;
            this.cap = cap;
            this.flow = flow;
        }
    }

    static int way(int x1, int y1, int x2, int y2) {
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.add(new int[]{0, x1, y1});
        int[][] h = new int[n][n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) Arrays.fill(h[i], INF);
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cur = q.poll();
            int v = cur[0], x = cur[1], y = cur[2];
            h[x][y] = v;
            if (x > 0 && m[x-1][y] && h[x-1][y] > h[x][y] + 1) {
                if ((x-1 == x2 && y == y2 && temp[x-1][y] >= h[x][y] + 1) ||
                    (!(x-1 == x2 && y == y2) && temp[x-1][y] > h[x][y] + 1))
                    q.add(new int[]{v+1, x-1, y});
            }
            if (y > 0 && m[x][y-1] && h[x][y-1] > h[x][y] + 1) {
                if ((x == x2 && y-1 == y2 && temp[x][y-1] >= h[x][y] + 1) ||
                    (!(x == x2 && y-1 == y2) && temp[x][y-1] > h[x][y] + 1))
                    q.add(new int[]{v+1, x, y-1});
            }
            if (x < n-1 && m[x+1][y] && h[x+1][y] > h[x][y] + 1) {
                if ((x+1 == x2 && y == y2 && temp[x+1][y] >= h[x][y] + 1) ||
                    (!(x+1 == x2 && y == y2) && temp[x+1][y] > h[x][y] + 1))
                    q.add(new int[]{v+1, x+1, y});
            }
            if (y < n-1 && m[x][y+1] && h[x][y+1] > h[x][y] + 1) {
                if ((x == x2 && y+1 == y2 && temp[x][y+1] >= h[x][y] + 1) ||
                    (!(x == x2 && y+1 == y2) && temp[x][y+1] > h[x][y] + 1))
                    q.add(new int[]{v+1, x, y+1});
            }
        }
        return h[x2][y2];
    }

    static void add_edge(int a, int b, int cap) {
        Edge e1 = new Edge(a, b, cap, 0);
        Edge e2 = new Edge(b, a, 0, 0);
        g[a].add(e.size());
        e.add(e1);
        g[b].add(e.size());
        e.add(e2);
    }

    static boolean bfs() {
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.add(0);
        Arrays.fill(d, -1);
        d[0] = 0;
        int sink = n * n * 2 + 1;
        while (!q.isEmpty() && d[sink] == -1) {
            int v = q.poll();
            for (int id : g[v]) {
                int to = e.get(id).b;
                if (d[to] == -1 && e.get(id).flow < e.get(id).cap) {
                    q.add(to);
                    d[to] = d[v] + 1;
                }
            }
        }
        return d[sink] != -1;
    }

    static int dfs(int v, int flow) {
        if (flow == 0) return 0;
        if (v == n * n * 2 + 1) return flow;
        for (; ptr[v] < g[v].size(); ptr[v]++) {
            int id = g[v].get(ptr[v]);
            int to = e.get(id).b;
            if (d[to] != d[v] + 1) continue;
            int pushed = dfs(to, Math.min(flow, e.get(id).cap - e.get(id).flow));
            if (pushed > 0) {
                e.get(id).flow += pushed;
                e.get(id ^ 1).flow -= pushed;
                return pushed;
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }

    static int max_flow() {
        int flow = 0;
        while (true) {
            if (!bfs()) break;
            Arrays.fill(ptr, 0);
            int pushed;
            while ((pushed = dfs(0, INF)) > 0) flow += pushed;
        }
        return flow;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        t = sc.nextInt();
        sc.nextLine();
        m = new boolean[n][n];
        temp = new int[n][n];
        kaps = new int[n][n];
        g = new ArrayList[MAXN];
        for (int i = 0; i < MAXN; i++) g[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        e = new ArrayList<>();
        d = new int[MAXN];
        ptr = new int[MAXN];

        Queue<int[]> l = new LinkedList<>();
        int k = 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                char x = line.charAt(j);
                temp[i][j] = t;
                if (x == 'Z') {
                    xb = i;
                    yb = j;
                    m[i][j] = false;
                } else if (x == 'Y') {
                    m[i][j] = false;
                } else {
                    m[i][j] = true;
                }
                int cap = (x == 'Z' || x == 'Y') ? 0 : x - '0';
                add_edge(0, k++, cap);
            }
        }
        k = n * n + 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                char x = line.charAt(j);
                if (x >= '0' && x <= '9') kaps[i][j] = x - '0';
                int cap = (x == 'Z' || x == 'Y') ? 0 : x - '0';
                add_edge(k++, n * n * 2 + 1, cap);
            }
        }
        l.add(new int[]{0, xb, yb});
        while (!l.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cur = l.poll();
            int v = cur[0], x = cur[1], y = cur[2];
            temp[x][y] = v;
            if (x > 0 && v + 1 < temp[x-1][y] && m[x-1][y]) {
                l.add(new int[]{v+1, x-1, y});
            }
            if (y > 0 && v + 1 < temp[x][y-1] && m[x][y-1]) {
                l.add(new int[]{v+1, x, y-1});
            }
            if (x < n-1 && v + 1 < temp[x+1][y] && m[x+1][y]) {
                l.add(new int[]{v+1, x+1, y});
            }
            if (y < n-1 && v + 1 < temp[x][y+1] && m[x][y+1]) {
                l.add(new int[]{v+1, x, y+1});
            }
        }
        k = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                int node1 = n * n;
                k++;
                for (int z = 0; z < n; z++) {
                    for (int w = 0; w < n; w++) {
                        node1++;
                        if (m[i][j] && m[z][w] && way(i, j, z, w) <= t) {
                            add_edge(k, node1, INF);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        System.out.println(max_flow());
        sc.close();
    }
}
